joints.name: arm_hang
joints.why: P1 R1 weights round 19: the hanging arm keyed AT THE GAME POSE (correctives.game_a_key): B posed as the game poses it in a shot, laid on A's surface as the game poses A in the same shot (rest twins, where B's rest lies on A). The strip key (arm_hang 8 deg, fold fair) posed the trunk at rest and an arm the game never holds: her right arm hangs past it, the RBF clamped at 1 and the fair shape squared the cap (Look cap_r p95 14.8 mm off A, armpit_r 12.8). Keys: her right arm in the Look (worn by both arms, mirrored), her left arm in the Look and in the town close-up (arm back, elbow bent; mirrored onto the right when it takes that line). The right arm's close-up key is left out: 9.4 deg from the Look's, it made the RBF ill-conditioned (|M| 6.9, the Look shape at full weight 45 deg from its key); the Look shape alone holds the close-up within 1-3 mm. Mask from the upper arm's rest head: 2 cm under it, 11/12/12 cm, full inside half (the top of the cap up to the trapezius: at 11 cm tall the left cap kept 12 mm at its top).
